extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The value approached as input approaches a point.

extracted_concepts.name: One-Sided Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Limit taken from one side of a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit at Infinity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Behavior of f(x) as x grows without bound.

extracted_concepts.name: Squeeze Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If g ≤ f ≤ h and the outer limits equal L, then the middle limit equals L.

extracted_concepts.name: Continuity at a Point
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function is continuous at a if lim_{x→a} f(x) = f(a).

extracted_concepts.name: Horizontal Asymptote
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line approached by the function as x tends to infinity.

extracted_concepts.name: Vertical Asymptote
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line where function values grow unbounded near a finite x.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Instantaneous rate of change defined as a limit.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line touching a curve with slope f'(a).

extracted_concepts.name: Secant Line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line through two points on a curve.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Existence of a derivative at a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(x^n) = nx^{n-1}.

extracted_concepts.name: Product Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: (fg)' = f'g + fg'.

extracted_concepts.name: Implicit Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differentiating equations not solved for y.

extracted_concepts.name: Higher-Order Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivatives such as f'', f''', and f^{(n)}.

extracted_concepts.name: L'Hospital's Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: For 0/0 or ∞/∞, lim f/g = lim f'/g'.

extracted_concepts.name: Extreme Value Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A continuous function on [a,b] has absolute max/min.

extracted_concepts.name: Critical Point
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Point where f'(c) = 0 or f' is undefined.

extracted_concepts.name: First Derivative Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Classifies critical points using sign changes of f'.

extracted_concepts.name: Second Derivative Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses f'' to classify critical points.

extracted_concepts.name: Concavity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Determined by the sign of f''.

extracted_concepts.name: Optimization
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Finding maximum or minimum values subject to constraints.

extracted_concepts.name: Riemann Sum
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Finite sum approximating area under a curve.

extracted_concepts.name: Definite Integral
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Limit of Riemann sums, written ∫_a^b f(x)dx.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects derivatives and definite integrals.

extracted_concepts.name: Integration by Substitution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Reverses the chain rule to evaluate integrals.

extracted_concepts.name: Area Between Curves
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Area = ∫_a^b |f(x) - g(x)|dx.

extracted_concepts.name: Differential Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equation involving derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Slope Field
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Visual representation of dy/dx.

extracted_concepts.name: Separation of Variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Solves equations by integrating g(y)dy and f(x)dx.
